acquisition_method.evidence: Up to twelve most intense peaks (charge state ≥ 2) were fragmented and tandem mass spectrum was acquired with a resolution of 35,000 and automatic dynamic exclusion for BALF and mucus plugs samples and with a resolution of 17,500 and dynamic exclusion 10 s for epithelial cells.

For absolute quantification a separate targeted mass-spectrometry method was used where only precursors and their fragments of the heavy and corresponding light peptides were scanned with a resolution of 35,000.
